Example Group AB: Interim report January–September 2026

Third quarter 2026
• Net sales increased by 12% to SEK 812.4 million (725.1)
• Operating profit (EBIT) amounted to SEK 96.3 million (71.0)
• EBIT margin was 11.9% (9.8)
• Profit for the period was SEK 70.2 million (52.6)
• Earnings per share¹ amounted to SEK 1.84 (1.38)

January–September 2026
• Net sales amounted to SEK 2,301.7 million (2,104.9)
• Operating profit (EBIT) amounted to SEK 241.0 million (198.4)

CEO comment
Demand in the third quarter of 2026 remained strong in all regions. Order
intake rose to SEK 845.0 million (760.2), and we see a continued good market
for 2027.

¹ Before and after dilution.
